claim: Kandy's functional importance appears to exceed its resident municipal scale because UDA planning data report large daily employment, education, commuter and pilgrim flows relative to the municipal population.
bounded_by: UDA flow categories use heterogeneous definitions and an unclear reference year; they are not a functional-agglomeration population, and proximity to Colombo remains a major confounder.
notes: Narrow replacement hypothesis after D result on unqualified economic-success framing.
